name: Muse Code
summary: Meta 的终端编程 agent：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行、或由 Kiteline 在后台运行时可回复和中断
summaryEn: Meta's terminal coding agent: view sessions, status and full conversations; reply and interrupt when it runs in tmux or in the background through Kiteline

cli.note: 回复需要 Muse Code 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）；从手机确认命令暂未开放
从手机操作暂未开放（Windows 上还没实测），只能查看
回复需要 Muse Code 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）；从手机确认命令暂未开放

limitsNote: Muse Code 不在本机记录订阅额度（在 Muse Code 中运行 muse usage 查看），「今日用量」中不显示；用 Meta API Key 按量付费时请在 Meta 开发者后台查看。token 按 Muse Code 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: Muse Code doesn't record your plan allowance on your computer (run muse usage in Muse Code to see it), so it isn't shown under Today's usage; with pay-as-you-go Meta API keys, check the Meta developer dashboard. Tokens are counted from Muse Code's own records
speaker: Muse
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.

gaps.text: Windows 上从手机回复、确认、中断还没实测，暂未开放，只能查看（Kiteline 已能往 Windows 终端里发按键，逐家实测后开放）
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming and interrupting from your phone on Windows aren't tested yet, so they're off and sessions are view-only (Kiteline can now type into Windows terminals; each agent is enabled once tested)

gaps.text: 从手机确认命令还没用真实账号实测，暂未开放：Muse Code 等你确认时，请在电脑上确认
gaps.textEn: Confirming commands from your phone hasn't been tested with a real account yet, so it isn't available: when Muse Code asks for confirmation, confirm on your computer

gaps.text: 回答提问还没做：没有真实账号，看不到它的提问界面，请在电脑上回答
gaps.textEn: Answering questions isn't built yet: without a real account its question interface couldn't be examined, so answer on your computer

gaps.text: 对话里的工具调用（运行的命令、改的文件）还没用真实账号核对，可能显示不全
gaps.textEn: Tool calls in the conversation (commands run, files changed) haven't been checked with a real account and may not all show

gaps.text: Mac 上还没实测（Linux 上已全部实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac (fully tested on Linux)
